headline: Apple’s HomeView ad is confusing to everyone except parents
summary: Apple's new HomeView ad is fast-paced and chaotic. It depicts a messy morning routine of a family of five. Parents, however, find the realistic portrayal relatable.

headline: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
summary: An OpenAI engineer was arrested for planting a sophisticated recording device. The employee, Abdulrahman Alfozan, faces charges related to intercepting oral communications. The device was found hidden in one of the company's offices.

headline: It looks like Apple Music is getting a new icon
summary: Apple Music's iconic red app icon is reportedly changing to black-and-white. The new icon was spotted in the latest iOS 27.2 beta. A slightly sharper eighth note design also appears.

headline: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
summary: Shopify is expanding its agentic commerce ambitions. Shoppers can now configure AI agents to purchase products on their behalf. Over a billion listings in Shopify's catalog will be accessible to more AI agents.

headline: MSI Codex R2 RTX 5070 Prebuilt Gaming PC Drops to $1449 With Free Delivery
summary: The MSI Codex R2 prebuilt gaming PC with RTX 5070 is now $1449. It's an excellent option for 1080p and 1440p gaming. This PC is also capable of running games in 4K.

headline: Fanttik Has a Great Deal on an All-in-One Electric Air Duster and Power Bank
summary: Get the Fanttik B10 Pro Max Electric Air Duster and Power Bank for $44.99. This limited-time deal includes free shipping. Apply the coupon code to access this offer.

headline: VisionQuest: What You Need to Remember Before the New MCU Show
summary: Prepare for the new MCU show, VisionQuest. Get all the essential details about Vision and Wanda. Learn about Tommy and Billy and more crucial background.

headline: Peak Has Been Leaked for PS5 by the ESRB
summary: The beloved co-op adventure game, Peak, is coming to PS5. The game's release was leaked by the ESRB rating. This confirms a PlayStation 5 version is on the way.

headline: Family pays tribute to 'warm and engaging' man killed in tiger attack
summary: William Chapman was tragically killed by a tiger. The incident occurred after he entered its pen. His family pays tribute to the 'warm and engaging' man.

headline: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
summary: Pope Leo was diagnosed with lung cancer. He underwent successful surgery to remove a lower lung lobe. The Vatican confirmed the successful procedure.

headline: Saudi man charged with planting 'sophisticated' recording device in OpenAI office
summary: A Saudi man faces charges for planting a recording device at OpenAI. The device was found in a TV's USB port, wrapped in toilet paper. Prosecutors describe it as a 'sophisticated' bug.

headline: MI5 chief warns of threats to UK from Russia, Iran and AI
summary: MI5 Director General Sir Ken McCallum issued a warning. He highlighted threats to the UK from Russia, Iran, and Artificial Intelligence. Operations tackling terrorism and state threats are now of 'equal scale.'
